2608.03817.title: UHP Detection: LVLMs have their Unique Hallucination Pattern in the Consistency Space
2608.03817.paper_summary: Large vision--language models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong multimodal reasoning capabilities but remain prone to hallucination, where model predictions are not grounded in visual evidence. Existing black-box hallucination detection methods estimate uncertainty through a single consistency metric, implicitly assuming that model uncertainty can be adequately characterized by a single measure. However, hallucinations exhibit diverse manifestations of uncertainty across different behavioral probes, making a single measure insufficient to characterize their underlying behavior. We propose \emph{Unique Hallucination Pattern (UHP) Detection}, a fully black-box framework that models hallucination as a structured uncertainty pattern defined by two axes: perturbation modality (image vs.\ text) and logical polarity (a statement vs.\ its negation). Their intersection produces four complementary consistency groups that capture distinct manifestations of model uncertainty, from which both within-group and between-group features are extracted to train a lightweight classifier. Through comprehensive experiments on AMBER and PhD across three LVLMs, UHP Detection consistently outperforms prior black-box and white-box baselines, with improvements of up to $+18.72\%$ AUC-ROC and $+20.07\%$ AUC-PR over the strongest black-box methods. Extensive ablation studies demonstrate that each consistency group contributes complementary information and that their combination forms a structured hallucination pattern. Furthermore, cross-dataset evaluation shows that this learned pattern generalizes across benchmarks, indicating that hallucination behavior reflects a model-specific consistency pattern. \textbf{Code is publicly available at} https://github.com/amirezzati/uhpdet.
2608.03817.paper_summary_zh: 大型視覺-語言模型（LVLMs）展示了強大的多模態推理能力，但仍然容易出現幻覺，即模型預測未能基於視覺證據。現有的黑箱幻覺檢測方法通過單一的一致性指標來估計不確定性，隱含地假設模型的不確定性可以通過單一度量來充分表徵。然而，幻覺在不同行為探測中表現出多樣化的不確定性，這使得單一度量不足以表徵其潛在行為。我們提出了\emph{獨特幻覺模式（UHP）檢測}，這是一個完全黑箱的框架，將幻覺建模為由兩個軸定義的結構化不確定性模式：擾動方式（圖像與文本）和邏輯極性（陳述與其否定）。它們的交集產生四個互補的一致性組，捕捉模型不確定性的不同表現，從中提取組內和組間特徵以訓練輕量級分類器。通過對三個LVLM的AMBER和PhD進行全面實驗，UHP檢測始終超越先前的黑箱和白箱基準，對最強的黑箱方法的AUC-ROC和AUC-PR分別提高了高達$+18.72\%$和$+20.07\%$。廣泛的消融研究表明，每個一致性組提供互補信息，並且它們的組合形成了一個結構化的幻覺模式。此外，跨數據集評估顯示這一學習模式在基準中具有泛化能力，表明幻覺行為反映了模型特定的一致性模式。 \textbf{代碼可在} https://github.com/amirezzati/uhpdet公開獲得。
